skill.summary: Analyzes code for bugs, security flaws, complexity, and style issues; provides improvement suggestions and potential automatic fixes.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Code Reviewer skill.
- Provides automated code quality analysis, detecting bugs and security issues.
- Suggests improvements for code quality, security, performance, and best practices.
- Includes tool functions for code review, complexity analysis, and design pattern detection.
- Customizable rules for code review focus areas and thresholds.
